instructions: Notes server for a personal notebook. list_notes finds notes by tag or text; update_note changes a note's title or body; delete_note removes a note permanently.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: Lists notes in the notebook, newest first. Filter by tag or by text in the title or body. Returns each note's id, title, tags and last-edited time.

tag.description: Only notes with this tag, such as work.

text.description: Only notes whose title or body contains this text.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return (1-100, default 20).

tools.name: update_note
tools.title: Update note
tools.description: Changes the title or body of one note. Fields left out stay as they are; the new body replaces the old one.

id.description: Id of the note, as returned by list_notes.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete note
tools.description: Deletes one note permanently. The note cannot be restored.

id.description: Id of the note, as returned by list_notes.
